contract: Extend the approved local graphite/mint workspace with one main orchestrator chat, selected compact agent context, and a human approval queue. Keep drafts visibly pending and editable, separate proposal/approval provenance, and make optional provider spending limits and audit history easy to find. Preserve existing concurrent agent chats. Autopilot remains off; no autonomous replies or management actions. Desktop uses chat plus context/queue; narrow screens keep a reachable composer and scroll context below it. Reference: existing Vizor stages one/two and user authorization for stages three/four plus spending limits.

accessibility.evidence: Chromium Axe A/AA checks pass for desktop/mobile orchestrator, mobile audit and spending controls, in addition to the original onboarding/workspace checks. Labelled forms, focusable scroll regions, keyboard navigation and Escape dismissal are exercised. This is not a complete assistive-technology certification.

responsive.evidence: Inspected both target sizes. Desktop chat, selected context and pending action controls remain legible. Fixed mobile conversation sizing; the composer is reachable, context/proposals scroll within the page region, no body-height or width overflow occurs, budget cards stack and ledger tables scroll locally.

loading.evidence: Chat shows Thinking/Stop while streaming. Proposal approval and budget-save controls show busy states and disable repeated clicks. Audit requests show loading and pagination controls.

empty.evidence: Orchestrator setup explains its provider choice, empty approval queue says nothing is waiting, and first-use spending controls explain optional limits without inventing a dollar amount.

error.evidence: Budget exhaustion blocks direct chat, orchestrator and connection tests with clear recovery guidance. Unknown prices/token counts fail closed; stale edits and failed actions preserve explicit error states. Unknown costs display Unavailable.

partial.evidence: Cancellation/restart retain partial text and conservative ledger accounting when final usage is missing. Bounded tool continuation can leave proposals for review without executing them.

success.evidence: Edited drafts are approved once, the target chat labels their approved orchestrator origin, management proposals change the target only on approval, and saved limits show current spend/reservations and an 80 percent warning.

permission.evidence: Autopilot off is always visible on the orchestrator. Native sends and management changes only queue drafts. Approval snapshots record exact payload and human approval; foreign-owner access and forged provenance are rejected in automated tests.

renderedEvidence.observation: Main orchestrator chat with provider/model, composer, selected agent and explicit Approve/Edit/Reject draft controls; existing sidebar remains familiar.
Long history scrolls inside the bounded agent panel and the composer stays reachable; context and proposals are available by scrolling the outer conversation region.
Provider cards show spend, monthly limits and reserved balance, with an 80 percent warning and a persistent review link.
Budget amount, progress and labelled controls stack in one narrow column with no page-width overflow.
